message:
The other day, I found myself in one of those classic "I told you so" moments. You know, the kind where you just can’t help but smirk a little? A storm was brewing, and while everyone else was busy scrolling through their phones, I was calmly pulling out my trusty old lantern and checking the batteries in my radio. My husband rolled his eyes and muttered something about me being overly cautious. But when the winds picked up and the lights flickered, I couldn’t resist a little grin as I handed him a flashlight. 

Sometimes, a little preparation goes a long way, even if it means being the family’s designated worrywart. If you have a tip for staying ahead of the weather, I’d love to hear it! ☔
